get.description:
Read-only shared listings filtered toward the owner's target role(s).

Never writes into the owner's own tracked jobs — see
``POST /job-catalog/save`` for that explicit step.

put.description:
Replace the owner's job-catalog role filter.

A PUT of the full desired list is naturally idempotent, so this does not
require an Idempotency-Key like the create/import/analyze endpoints.

post.description:
Copy one catalog listing into the owner's own tracked jobs, once.

Idempotent per (owner, platform, external_id) — saving the same listing
twice returns the same tracked job rather than creating a duplicate.
Catalog external ids may be URLs, so this uses a request body instead of
putting those values in the path.

get.description: Free-text search across the whole shared job catalog, independent of role filtering.

post.description: Compatibility path for simple catalog ids that fit in a single segment.
post.summary: Save Job Catalog Listing By Path

get.description: Return non-sensitive service metadata for compatible clients.

post.description:
Enqueue declared-link enrichment; the worker fetches and materializes it.

Returns immediately with a job to poll rather than running the fetch
inline, so a slow or unavailable third-party profile page never blocks
the request.
